patches_removed.name: Disable analytics
patches_removed.description: Stops Instagram from sending usage reports and crash reports to Instagram and Facebook. It also skips the contacts and location setup screens. Restart Instagram after you change it. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches_removed.name: Open developer options
patches_removed.description: A long press on the Home tab opens Instagram's own developer options, where you can change its hidden settings. A wrong change can break parts of Instagram until you reset it. On once you patch it in. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Developer.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Threads button
patches_modified.description: Takes the Threads button off the top of profiles, with switches for the Create button and Share profile on your own. The menu and the other buttons stay. Each starts off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Profiles.
patches_modified.previous_description: Takes the Threads button off the top of profiles. The menu and the other buttons stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Pro (IPTV)
patches_modified.description: Deactivates subscription_needed, forces the pro entitlement active, and spoofs Google Play for app-internal installer-source checks.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Pro (IPTV)
patches_modified.description: Deactivates subscription_needed, forces the pro entitlement active, and spoofs Google Play for app-internal installer-source checks.

patches_modified.name: Clean up Reels
patches_modified.description: Hides clutter on reels, such as the Follow button, comment previews, Remix and Use template buttons and Threads cards between reels, so more of the video shows, and can play each reel once instead of over and over, keep its original audio instead of a Meta AI dub, drop the search pill under the caption, or hide the like, comment and share counts or the Save button. It can also open a video you tap in the feed on its own, with no reels after it. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides clutter on reels, such as the Follow button, comment previews, Remix and Use template buttons and Threads cards between reels, so more of the video shows, and can play each reel once instead of over and over, keep its original audio instead of a Meta AI dub, drop the search pill under the caption or hide the like, comment and share counts. It can also open a video you tap in the feed on its own, with no reels after it. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Disable ads
patches_modified.description: Disables banner, interstitial, native, app-open and rewarded ads, and the squad builder's video ad panel.

patches_modified.name: Disable ads
patches_modified.description: Forces AdsRemovalSettings.areAdsDisabled() to return true, disabling banner, interstitial, MPU, hero placement, coverage sponsorship and announcement ads.

patches_added.name: GmsCore support
patches_added.description: Makes Google sign-in and Google APIs work in the patched app by using MicroG RE instead of Google Play services. Requires MicroG RE to be installed. FotMob's Sign in with Google needs it. FotMob's automatic sign-in at first start is skipped, because MicroG RE would show it as an account chooser; use the Sign in with Google button instead.

patches_added.name: Spoof signature
patches_added.description: Makes the app report its original signing certificate to itself, so Firebase and Google APIs restricted to the original app keep working.

patches_modified.name: Disable ads
patches_modified.description: Disables Google Mobile Ads (AdMob) initialization and the app's own ad placements, removing banner, interstitial, rewarded, native and mediated ads.

patches_modified.name: Disable update prompts
patches_modified.description: Hides the "This app is out of date" screen and the new version popup, so the patched version keeps working.

patches_modified.name: Enable Premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks 365Scores premium features (ad-free, tipster, plus, delayed notifications and notification sounds).

patches_added.name: GmsCore support
patches_added.description: Makes Google sign-in and Google APIs work in the patched app by using MicroG RE instead of Google Play services. Requires MicroG RE to be installed. Shazam's Sign in with Google needs it. Shazam's automatic sign-in attempts are skipped, because MicroG RE would show them as an account chooser; use the Sign in with Google button instead.

patches_added.name: Spoof signature
patches_added.description: Makes the app report its original signing certificate to itself, so Firebase and Google APIs restricted to the original app keep working. Also connects Shazam to Spotify through Spotify's login page instead of the Spotify app, which rejects the patched app (use email/password or email code; Google and Apple login don't work there).

patches_added.name: Disable rating prompts
patches_added.description: Stops the in-app rating dialog that opens after repeated app starts.

patches_added.name: Hide betting content
patches_added.description: Hides odds, bookmaker links and betting offers: odds in lists and match pages, the Odds tabs, Bet365 sign-up links and the promotions for streaming, tickets and betting.

patches_modified.name: Block marketing notifications
patches_modified.description: Blocks in-app promotional prompts, modals, promotion banners and Firebase In-App Messaging popups. Note: this only affects in-app promotions. Match-alert push delivery on re-signed builds needs "GmsCore support" with MicroG RE (issue #25).

patches_added.name: Controller velocity frame
patches_added.description: Fixes thrown-object directions by rotating controller speeds into the frame SteamVR expects. Builds: 2.0.23, angular velocity is reported local to the streamed pose; 2.0.20 - 2.0.22, it is reported in the base space. Angles measured on 2.0.23/5002363. Needs: nothing.
